question: What will be the percentage change in front-month gold futures (GC=F on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-07-31 to the close on 2026-08-31?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-08-31 / close on 2026-07-31 - 1), using daily closes of GC=F on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-08-31, the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't open the resolution page, but search snippets put the July 31 GC=F close at about $4,049.10. Nothing that happened by August 3 settles the question. Many search results were dated after August 3 and I left them all out, as the exercise requires.

## 1. Resolution source
- Yahoo GC=F history page (finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/history): the proxy refused the connection, so I couldn't open it directly.
- 2026-07-31: A search snippet of that page, labelled "Gold Dec 26 (GC=F)", shows a close of **4,049.10** and a day range of 4,022.40 to 4,102.40. This close is the baseline. [Yahoo GC=F history](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC%3DF/history)
- Caveat: the snippet suggests GC=F was already tracking the December 2026 contract, so a contract roll during August looks unlikely. Yahoo's July 31 article still talked about "August gold futures", and its August 3 article quoted December futures. One other snippet gave a July 31 Comex close of $4,135.80, which conflicts with Yahoo's figure.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The resolution date is a month away.
- 2026-08-03: December futures opened at $4,135.20, up 0.7% from Friday's close, and were at $4,111.50 by 7:58 a.m. ET. Yahoo said prices opened higher after the U.S. paused planned airstrikes. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/gold-prices-today-monday-august-3-2026-gold-prices-open-higher-after-us-pauses-planned-airstrikes-121655731.html)
- 2026-08-03: Spot gold was $4,045.55 at 9:00 a.m. ET. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/amp/select/the-price-of-gold-today-august-3-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-31: Yahoo headline: "Gold price finally breaks above $4,100 as U.S. paused airstrikes overnight". [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/gold-prices-today-friday-july-31-2026-gold-price-finally-breaks-above-4100-as-us-paused-airstrikes-overnight-123436216.html)
- 2026-07-31: CME said gold futures slipped on rising Treasury yields and were on track for a third weekly decline. [CME](https://www.cmegroup.com/videos/2026/07/31/gold-futures-slip-as-rising-treasury-yields-weigh-on-prices-7-3.html)
- 2026-07-31: AlgoIndex: "Every reason to rally, and it didn't". It said the December contract settled at 4,160.6 on July 30. [AlgoIndex](https://algoindex.com/market-outlook/gold-gc-every-reason-to-rally-and-it-didnt-july-31-2026)
- 2026-07-29: Under Chair Kevin Warsh, the Fed held rates at 3.50 to 3.75% and gave no forward guidance. The vote was 9-3, and all three dissenters wanted a hike. Spot gold rose almost 2% to about $4,102. [Kitco](https://www.kitco.com/news/article/2026-07-29/gold-price-jumps-federal-reserve-leaves-interest-rates-unchanged), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-29/gold-advances-after-federal-reserve-keeps-interest-rates-on-hold)
- 2026-07-15: Comex gold settled at $4,044.00, 23.96% below its record of $5,318.40 set on 2026-01-29. [Morningstar/DJ](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202607157264/comex-gold-settles-042-lower-at-404400-data-talk)
- 2026-07-07: Comex gold settled at $4,145.30. [Morningstar/DJ](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202607076051/comex-gold-settles-024-lower-at-414530-data-talk)
- June 2026: Gold fell more than 12%, on track for its biggest monthly drop since October 2008. [Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/commodities/gold-falls-over-12-in-june-2026-set-for-biggest-monthly-decline-since-october-2008-malayalam)

## 4. Base rates
- In July 2026, Comex gold traded roughly between $4,000 and $4,160. The July 7 and July 15 settles and the July 31 close imply a month-to-date move of only a few percent.
- Volatility in 2026 has been unusually high. Gold peaked on Jan 29, fell more than 12% in June alone, and was about 24% to 28% off the high by late July.
- Long-run pattern (general knowledge, not taken from a source here): gold's monthly moves typically have a standard deviation of about 4 to 5%. 2026's realized volatility looks clearly higher, so moves of ±8 to 12% in a month are plausible.
- Drivers so far in 2026: oil and Iran-conflict inflation pushing up odds of Fed hikes (bearish for gold), against central-bank buying (supportive).

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-29: BeInCrypto put gold near $4,020, 28% below its January high. It said the weekly chart still favored sellers after three weekly closes below its channel midline, and noted central-bank buying offsetting ETF outflows. [BeInCrypto](https://beincrypto.com/gold-price-outlook-august-2026/)
- Mid-2026: Discovery Alert's cycle analysis expects a bottom around $3,850 to $3,900 in late July or early August. Its bearish alternative is $3,500 to $3,600. [Discovery Alert](https://discoveryalert.com.au/gold-price-forecast-bottoming-process-mid-2026-cycle-support/)
- FXEmpire argued that the mid-year low was "a major bottom". [FXEmpire](https://www.fxempire.com/forecasts/article/gold-price-forecast-july-marked-a-major-bottom-miners-set-to-outperform-1616408)
- Kalshi lists hourly and weekly gold markets (kxgoldh, kxgoldw), but I couldn't find a monthly end-of-August contract or prices for one dated by August 3. I found no Polymarket or Manifold market. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxgoldw/gold-weekly-price-/kxgoldw-26aug2817)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
These dates come from the usual calendar pattern, not from sources I checked:
- 2026-08-07 (likely): July jobs report.
- Around 2026-08-12: July CPI.
- Around Aug 20 to 22: Jackson Hole symposium, possibly Warsh's first as Chair. This matters for September hike odds, which some coverage after July 29 put as high as about 76%.
- Late August: PCE inflation data. Also the expiry of the August contract, which shouldn't matter if GC=F is already on December.
- Ongoing: U.S.-Iran airstrike pauses or resumptions, oil prices and Treasury yields, which have been the main movers of gold in 2026.
